fusions.name: Spade Edge
fusions.desc: Drives a rock edge into the target, dealing 6 damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hurled Clod
fusions.desc: A hurled clod that deals 8 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Buried Charge
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to bury a trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 40 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 24 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Spoil Heap
fusions.desc: Each kill restores 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
